history.summary: Faber Residence is a GuocoLand-led 399-unit new launch (TOP Q1 2029) at Faber Walk, Clementi (D05), 99-year leasehold. This 4BR at $2,114 psf is below the project's $2,240 median and below Clementi's 2025 new-launch average, but the project has a key weakness — no MRT within walking distance — and the appreciation data carries new-launch bias.
history.rating_rationale: Web research confirms a credible new launch: reputable developer (GuocoLand/Hong Leong/TID), 399 units, TOP Q1 2029, launched from $1,995 psf and positioned ~20% below Clementi's 2025 new-launch average — a deliberate value play. This 4BR at $2,114 psf / $2.55M sits below the $2,240 project median, and at 1,206 sqft is an efficiently sized 4BR (not oversized), so the quantum is reasonable for a family unit. D05 is a genuine RCR growth district (One-North, future GSW spillover). The offsetting concerns: (1) no MRT within walking distance — the project's well-documented weakness, capping appreciation and rental appeal versus MRT-adjacent Clementi stock; (2) has_new_launch_bias is true, so the $2,240 'median' reflects developer pricing, not seasoned resale — there is no resale track record to underwrite; (3) buyers face holding through construction to 2029 before the hold clock effectively starts. A fairly priced new launch in a good district with a real transport gap — Neutral.
red_flags: No MRT within walking distance — the project's primary weakness
New-launch pricing bias — no resale track record; $2,240 'median' is developer pricing
Long runway to TOP Q1 2029 before resale/rental can be realized
catalysts: Reputable GuocoLand-led consortium; priced ~20% below Clementi 2025 new-launch average — value entry
D05 RCR growth (One-North tech hub, West Coast corridor)
Riverfront (Ulu Pandan) low-rise setting, scarce new stock in Faber Hills
